entry.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
entry.summary:
OpenAI is bringing its frontier models and Codex workflows to Google Cloud's Gemini Model Garden via the Google Cloud Marketplace.

Why it matters: Google Cloud users can now access and deploy OpenAI's frontier models and Codex workflows directly within their existing Google Cloud Marketplace environment.
